description: A scene-driven account of how the 1994 Stargate film became a weekly science-fiction adventure built around a team, a permanent base and a galaxy of addresses.

related_resources.reason: Original film premise, cast, plot frame, and director context.
Original broadcast run, original cast, producers and creators.
Film/show casting and naming differences, including O’Neil/O’Neill.
1997 pilot plot, premiere, writer/director credits, casting and first mission.
Deliberate series continuity changes from the film: spellings, places and cosmology.
Review of 1996 script draft, production origins, and changes before broadcast.
